title: Conditions
summary: Common combat conditions and their mechanical effects.

title: Actions in Combat
summary: Attack, Cast a Spell, Dash, Disengage, Dodge, Help, Hide, Ready, Search, and Use an Object.

entries.title: Common actions
entries.body: On your turn you can take one action. Common actions include Attack, Cast a Spell, Dash, Disengage, Dodge, Help, Hide, Ready, Search, and Use an Object.

title: Resting
summary: Short and long rest rules for recovery during play.

entries.title: Short rest
entries.body: A short rest is a period of downtime, at least 1 hour long, during which characters do nothing more strenuous than eating, drinking, reading, and tending wounds.

entries.title: Long rest
entries.body: A long rest is an extended downtime period used to recover hit points, features, and spell slots according to class rules.

title: Ability Checks
summary: Ability checks resolve uncertain actions using d20 plus the relevant ability modifier and proficiency when applicable.

entries.title: Core check
entries.body: Roll a d20 and add the relevant ability modifier. If a character has proficiency that applies, add proficiency bonus.

title: Saving Throws
summary: Saving throws resist harmful effects and use d20 plus an ability modifier and proficiency when applicable.

entries.title: Core save
entries.body: A saving throw represents an attempt to resist a spell, trap, poison, disease, or similar threat.

title: Equipment
summary: Weapons, armor, adventuring gear, tools, packs, and spellcasting focuses from SRD equipment data.

entries.title: Use at table
entries.body: Use equipment entries for quick lookup and to distinguish SRD equipment from custom or homebrew gear.

title: Spellcasting Basics
summary: Spell level, casting time, range, components, duration, concentration, rituals, and higher-level casting.

entries.title: Spell anatomy
entries.body: A spell entry includes level, school, casting time, range, components, duration, and the spell text. Some spells have ritual, concentration, or higher-level casting rules.
